arguments.heading: What happened at the argument
paragraphs: Frank Dunham represents Hamdi. He argues the government lacks authority. He says Hamdi has no hearing. He calls the government's stance unreasonable. He demands a factual review.
Paul Clement represents the government. He argues the executive has power. He claims the government can hold Hamdi. He asserts the detention is lawful. He rejects the need for a hearing.
Chief Justice Rehnquist introduces the case. He notes the parties. He invites the first advocate. He manages the oral argument.
